**Title:** Build Business Analytics Dashboard for User & Revenue Tracking

**Body:**

## Overview
Create a comprehensive business analytics dashboard to monitor product growth, user engagement, and revenue metrics. This dashboard will provide real-time insights into customer acquisition, user activity, and subscription revenue.

## Requirements

### 1. User Growth Metrics
- Total number of active users
- New user acquisition by:
  - Day
  - Month
  - Year
- Growth trends and visualization (line/bar charts)

### 2. User Activity Metrics
- Daily active users (DAU)
- Monthly active users (MAU)
- Activity trends by:
  - Day
  - Month
  - Year

### 3. Customer Segmentation
- User count breakdown by customer type:
  - **Household (Hộ gia đình)**
  - **Business/Enterprise (Doanh nghiệp)**
  - **Individual (Cá nhân)**
- Visualization: pie chart or bar chart showing distribution

### 4. Revenue & Subscription Metrics
- Total credits purchased in the system
- Revenue breakdown by:
  - Freemium users
  - Premium/Monthly subscription users
- Monthly recurring revenue (MRR) trend
- Subscription status distribution (Active, Expired, Canceled)

### 5. Technical Requirements
- Dashboard updates every hour (hourly refresh)
- Accessible to internal team for business monitoring
- Responsive design (desktop & mobile view)
- Export capability (CSV/PDF reports)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Dashboard displays all required metrics with accurate data
- [ ] Charts and visualizations are clear and interactive
- [ ] Hourly data refresh is working correctly
- [ ] User can filter data by date range (day/month/year)
- [ ] Dashboard loads in < 3 seconds
- [ ] All metrics are tested with sample data

## Implementation Notes
- Consider using a charting library (Chart.js, D3.js, or similar)
- Backend API should provide aggregated metrics to reduce query load
- Store hourly snapshots for historical analysis

---

**Title:** [Feature] Dashboard - User & Growth Metrics

**Body:**

## Overview
Build the first phase of the business analytics dashboard focused on user growth metrics and customer segmentation. This dashboard will display real-time data pulled from the existing customer database to track user acquisition, activity, and customer types.

## Requirements

### 1. User Growth Metrics
- **Total Active Users**: Count of all active users in the system
- **New User Acquisition**:
  - New users by day
  - New users by month
  - New users by year
- **Growth Trends**: Line/bar chart visualization showing user growth over time

### 2. User Activity Metrics
- **Daily Active Users (DAU)**: Users with at least one activity per day
- **Monthly Active Users (MAU)**: Users with at least one activity per month
- **Activity Trends**: Charts showing activity patterns by day/month/year

### 3. Customer Segmentation
- **User count breakdown by customer type**:
  - Household (Hộ gia đình)
  - Business/Enterprise (Doanh nghiệp)
  - Individual/Self-employed (Cá thể kinh doanh)
- **Visualization**: Pie chart or bar chart showing distribution by type
- **Filter capability**: Ability to view metrics for each customer segment separately

### 4. Data Source & Database Queries
- Query existing customer database tables:
  - `users` table (user_id, user_type, created_at, user_name)
  - `activities` or `logs` table (user_id, activity_timestamp, activity_type)
  - Ensure efficient queries with proper indexing on `created_at`, `user_type`, `activity_timestamp`
- Aggregate data at hourly intervals for dashboard refresh
- Store hourly snapshots for historical trend analysis

### 5. Technical Requirements
- Dashboard updates every hour
- Responsive design (desktop & mobile)
- Fast loading (< 3 seconds)
- Export capability (CSV format)
- Data accuracy verified against database

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Dashboard displays total active users with accurate count
- [ ] New user acquisition metrics (day/month/year) match database records
- [ ] DAU and MAU calculations are correct
- [ ] Customer segmentation data is accurate by type
- [ ] All charts render correctly and are interactive
- [ ] Hourly data refresh works without errors
- [ ] Users can filter data by date range
- [ ] Export to CSV functionality works
- [ ] Dashboard loads in < 3 seconds
- [ ] Database queries are optimized and don't impact system performance
- [ ] All metrics tested with actual data from production database

## Implementation Notes
- Identify and use existing database tables for customers and activities
- Consider creating a `dashboard_metrics` table to store hourly aggregates (improves performance)
- Implement proper database indexing on frequently queried columns
- Use ORM or raw SQL queries depending on existing tech stack
- Add data validation to ensure accuracy
- Consider pagination for large datasets

- **Monthly Active Users (MAU)**: Users with at least one activity per month

  - Ensure efficient queries with proper indexing on `created_at`, `user_type`, `activity_timestamp`
- Aggregate data at hourly intervals for dashboard refresh
- Store hourly snapshots for historical trend analysis

### 5. Technical Requirements

- Dashboard updates every hour
- Responsive design (desktop & mobile)

- [ ] All metrics tested with actual data from production database
- [ ] Portal structure supports adding future features (monitoring, configuration)

- Create main navigation/sidebar for future features

- Consider creating a `dashboard_metrics` table to store hourly aggregates (improves performance)
